The '''Auspice''' was a type of [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] manufactured by [[Walkhar]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Walkhar Auspice first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as one of the possible items players could receive from the Gatekeeper's Stronghold Pack.
